notes.text: New: Foldable device support with split-screen
New: Email messages can be printed
New: Unified folder account indicator identifies message ownership
New: Display account avatar in message notifications
Fixed: Edge-to-edge regressions affected account setup screens
Fixed: Tap behavior was unreliable in recipient fields
Fixed: Incorrect icon was displayed for 'Find folder'
Fixed: Device orientiation change duplicated recipient field text
Fixed: Copied link text incorrectly included CSS
Fixed: Unselecting 'Colorize contact pictures' setting did not persist
Fixed: Some general settings were not preserved after export and import
